notes.title: UPDATE - 19/MAR/2016 - Version: 1.4.0.6
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/dGRgO3w.jpg

Version: 1.4.0.6 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

This update adds steam cloud saving, fixes the steam not taking screenshots problem and changes a few things around a bit in the game's menu.

Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    Steam cloud support.
    Fixed screenshot error.
    Social icons open overlay instead of browser.
    Updated pixel puzzles banners.
    Pixel puzzles banners open overlay instead of browser.
[/olist]
Enjoy!!!

notes.title: UPDATE 3 - Fixes & Requested Stuff
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/tTt9fvD.png

This 3rd update includes a few needed fixes and added stuff that's been requested from players to be added into the main menu's zombie survival minigame.

Fixes:
 
    Blood effects reduced to lessen the slowdown some people have been experiencing in the menu minigame.
    Fixed menu minigame achievement timer.
 
Requested Updates:

    Darkened backing for main game weapon stats.
    Menu Minigame Kill counter.
    Menu Minigame Time counter.
    Menu Minigame Restart button.
 
Enjoy!!!
